shortDescription: According to Odaily citing a video released by the White House Rapid Response team, US President Trump, when responding to a question about the Binance hack, said: "We're learning about it. We don't know if it's North Korea — but if it is, we'll talk to North Korea about it."

title: Trump: If North Korea Is Involved in Binance Hack, U.S. Will Address It with Them
